name: Rudi Makes
tagline: Amp & synth repair and product design - Indianapolis
about_text: I'm a repair technician, backline tech and product designer in Indianapolis. Under Filament I fix tube amps, synthesizers and vintage keyboards, trace faults down to the component and write up every job. The rest of the time I design products of my own, starting with TBX Home Broadcast. Years inside gear that has lasted fifty years shapes how I design: simple to use, built to last, and made to be repaired.
